Add a new Rust module `src-tauri/src/backend/censor/model_options.rs` — the view-model for Devboule's OPT-IN local Censor model picker. The Censor's local AI tier is opt-in (the user selects a model); the multi-turn DEEP review mode is only available on tool-capable models. Implement EXACTLY:

1. `use serde::Serialize;` and `use std::collections::HashMap;` and bring in the catalog: `use super::catalog::{recommended_censor_models, RecommendTier};`
2. struct `ModelOption` (derive Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq) with pub fields: `tag: &'static str`, `label: &'static str`, `tier: RecommendTier`, `installed: bool`, `deep_eligible: bool`.
3. `pub fn censor_model_options(installed_tags: &[String], caps_by_tag: &HashMap<String, Vec<String>>) -> Vec<ModelOption>`: for EACH model from `recommended_censor_models()` in order, build a `ModelOption` where `installed` is true iff the model's `tag` is present in `installed_tags`, and `deep_eligible` is true iff the model is installed AND its runtime capabilities (`caps_by_tag.get(tag)`, e.g. from Ollama /api/show) contain the string "tools". A model that is tool-capable but NOT installed must have deep_eligible = false.

Idiomatic, warning-free, no unwrap() in non-test code, doc comments on public items. You MAY include a #[cfg(test)] mod tests (it will be ignored by scoring). Return ONLY the full file content.
